text:
Eleanor: Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands — dropping slides and notes here. Slides: https://redwood.ai/all-hands/apr-2024 Notes: https://docs.redwood.ai/teams/all-hands/2024-04 I'm collecting follow-ups and action items. TL;DR: Dedicated rollout, Private GA timeline, hiring for infra.

Jae: Quick question on Dedicated autoscaling — will customers be able to configure policy per-model or only per-pool? @Eleanor

Eleanor: Per-pool for the first pass. Per-model weighting is targeted for Q3 and we'll post the design in the product board.

Ravi: We should have clearer default autoscale configs. Action: Ravi to draft suggested defaults and open a docs PR by Fri. @Priya can you review?

Priya: Ack. I'll review — can we include a short section about cost tradeoffs (batching vs latency)?

Liam: On pricing: will Dedicated have commit discounts and how big are they roughly? @Eleanor

Eleanor: Yes — reserved capacity contracts will have tiered discounts. Finance will publish the pricing matrix next week.

Liam: I'll post the matrix into #finance when it's ready.

Sofia: Follow-up about Private GA infra baseline — slides mentioned 8xA100. Is that still the recommendation?

Jae: Baseline = 8xA100 for medium throughput. For high-throughput customers we recommend 32x configs with NVLink. We'll add an infra appendix to the guide.

all-hands-bot: Recording uploaded: https://zoom.redwood.ai/rec/abc123 Slides exported to team drive.

Priya: Can we get a consolidated action-items sheet? Ravi, can you create and share a sheet with owners + due dates?

Ravi: Done — https://sheets.redwood.ai/d/1X-example. Shared edit with product+eng.

Eleanor: Action owners for follow-ups: Ravi (autoscale defaults), Jae (infra appendix), Liam (pricing matrix), Priya (docs review). Please update the sheet by EOD Fri and mark blockers. If blocked ping me directly.

Jae: Clarification on rollout: will hosted API traffic be migrated automatically to Dedicated after a customer commits, or is it opt-in?

Eleanor: Opt-in. We'll provide migration tooling and an assisted onboarding package for customers that want help.

Sofia: Request from sales: can we surface known performance benchmarks in Console (per-model TPS/latency)? would help deals.

Priya: Good idea. We'll add a /benchmarks page in Console and surface model-level tps/latency numbers optionally.

Liam: FYI legal asked about SOC2 timeline for Private — they're aiming Q4. @Eleanor

Eleanor: Noted — legal + security will coordinate and we'll share the timeline in the next weekly sync.

Ravi: :thumbsup:

Priya: :raising_hand: small UX ask — can design sync with me about the placement of the rollout toggle in the Console?

Sofia: I'll set up a sync with design. Tuesday 10am work for you, @Priya?

Priya: Works for me.

Jae: Example of the rollout command we demoed:
```
rw rollout create --pool dedicated --model redwood-large-v2 --percent 10
```
Eleanor: Thanks all. I'll follow up with an email summary and updated links. Closing thread for Q&A; if you have more items add them to the sheet or ping me.
